name: @ahpd/push
description: Push notifications for the ahpd daemon: a push: resource provider a phone registers its Expo token with or a browser its Web Push subscription, and the senders that tell a device when a session needs a person
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Push
ahpd.description: Delivers push notifications to connected devices when agent sessions require user attention.

closers: the receipt reads still to come

title.description: What a notification is titled. The daemon's own name when absent.

accessToken.description: An Expo access token, where the project has push security on. A name may be given instead of the token, as {"$secret": "host:expo"}.

webPushHosts.description: The hosts a browser's push endpoint may be at, where a pattern of *.<domain> matches every host under that domain. An endpoint at another host is refused at the write.

contact.description: A mailto: or https: URI sent as the VAPID sub claim, which a push service may use to contact the operator. Absent means no sub claim.
